statement: Pinned WiinUSoft/WiinUPro project documentation describes a Windows Nintendo Bluetooth controller connection and translation to XInput, including Remote, Nunchuk, Classic/Classic Pro and some IR/motion/calibration settings. This is a Windows stack/emulated XInput consumer, not a Linux hidraw or evdev client; neither Linux virtual realization is an executable acceptance target for this specific Windows program without a distinct bridge.

applicability.revision: Pinned software consumer; retail Wii Remote revision not measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer; WiinUPro dc5700e ReadMe.txt 1-80; documented feature scope only, no native HID code execution verified.
